infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ideal Solutions Pro uses the microphone when you tap the mic button to dictate into text fields instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Ideal Solutions Pro uses speech recognition when you dictate into text fields with the mic button.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ideal Solutions Pro uses your location while the app is open to find nearby supply houses, show job sites on maps, and verify employee clock-in at work locations. Location is used only for app features — not to track you across other apps or websites.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Ideal Solutions Pro uses your location while the app is open to find nearby supply houses, show job sites on maps, and verify employee clock-in at work locations. Location is used only for app features — not to track you across other apps or websites.

plugins.contactsPermission: Ideal Solutions Pro can read your contacts when you pick a customer or employee from your address book, and save a customer you enter to your address book when you choose that option.

plugins.photosPermission: Ideal Solutions Pro uses your photo library when you choose a company logo or other images from your device.
plugins.cameraPermission: Ideal Solutions Pro uses your camera for optional clock-in verification photos.
